argv:
(version 1)
(deny default)
(allow process-fork)
(allow process-exec)
(allow signal (target same-sandbox))
(allow process-info* (target same-sandbox))
(allow sysctl-read)
(allow sysctl-write (sysctl-name "kern.grade_cputype"))
(allow iokit-open (iokit-registry-entry-class "RootDomainUserClient"))
(allow ipc-sysv*)
(allow user-preference-read)
(allow file-read-metadata)
(allow ipc-posix-sem)
(allow ipc-posix-shm*)
(allow pseudo-tty)
(allow system-socket)
(allow mach-lookup (global-name "com.apple.system.opendirectoryd.libinfo") (global-name "com.apple.system.opendirectoryd.membership") (global-name "com.apple.system.notification_center") (global-name "com.apple.system.logger") (global-name "com.apple.logd") (global-name "com.apple.FSEvents") (global-name "com.apple.PowerManagement.control") (global-name "com.apple.bsd.dirhelper"))
(allow file-read* (subpath "/usr") (subpath "/bin") (subpath "/sbin") (subpath "/System") (subpath "/private/etc") (subpath "/private/var/db/timezone") (subpath "/private/var/select") (subpath "/private/var/db/xcode_select_link") (subpath "/Library/Frameworks") (subpath "/Library/Developer") (subpath "/Library/Java") (subpath "/Library/Apple") (subpath "/Library/Python") (subpath "/opt") (subpath "/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer") (subpath "/dev") (subpath "/private/preboot/Cryptexes") (subpath "/private/var/db/dyld") (subpath "/Library/Preferences/Logging") (subpath "/private/var/db/DetachedSignatures"))
(allow file-map-executable (subpath "/usr") (subpath "/bin") (subpath "/sbin") (subpath "/System") (subpath "/private/etc") (subpath "/private/var/db/timezone") (subpath "/private/var/select") (subpath "/private/var/db/xcode_select_link") (subpath "/Library/Frameworks") (subpath "/Library/Developer") (subpath "/Library/Java") (subpath "/Library/Apple") (subpath "/Library/Python") (subpath "/opt") (subpath "/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer") (subpath "/dev") (subpath "/private/preboot/Cryptexes") (subpath "/private/var/db/dyld") (subpath "/Library/Preferences/Logging") (subpath "/private/var/db/DetachedSignatures"))
(deny file-read* file-write* (subpath "/System/Volumes/Data"))
(allow file-read* file-write* (literal "/dev/null") (literal "/dev/zero") (literal "/dev/tty") (literal "/dev/dtracehelper") (literal "/dev/ptmx") (regex #"^/dev/fd/"))
(allow file-ioctl (literal "/dev/dtracehelper") (literal "/dev/ptmx") (literal "/dev/tty"))
(allow file-read* file-write* (subpath (param "P0")))
(allow file-map-executable (subpath (param "P1")))
(deny file-write-unlink (literal (param "P2")))
(allow file-read* file-write* (subpath (param "P3")))
(allow file-map-executable (subpath (param "P4")))
(deny file-write-unlink (literal (param "P5")))
(allow file-read* (subpath (param "P6")))
(allow file-map-executable (subpath (param "P7")))
(deny file-write* (subpath (param "P8")))
(allow network-outbound (remote ip "*:*"))
(allow network-outbound (remote unix-socket (path-literal "/private/var/run/mDNSResponder")))
(allow file-read* (literal "/private/var/run/resolv.conf"))
(allow mach-lookup (global-name "com.apple.SystemConfiguration.configd") (global-name "com.apple.SystemConfiguration.DNSConfiguration") (global-name "com.apple.dnssd.service") (global-name "com.apple.networkd") (global-name "com.apple.nehelper") (global-name "com.apple.SecurityServer") (global-name "com.apple.trustd") (global-name "com.apple.trustd.agent") (global-name "com.apple.ocspd"))
(deny network-outbound (remote ip "localhost:*"))
(allow network-bind network-inbound (local tcp "localhost:8000"))
